activity_summary: You rehearsed the comedy once more and Garnish still had no total. Kemp wanted room for tomorrow and was not given a number. Burbage kept the refusal. Sincler kept the half-line small. You said you are not in this afternoon's Shrew. Nick was released until two of the clock tomorrow.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Refused a tally, kept the pause, and said he is not in the afternoon play.

entities.name: Abel Garnish
entities.context: Read no figure, and shut the book with the margin still blank.

entities.name: Will Kemp
entities.context: Asked again for the underfed word, and was told to wait for a yard.

entities.name: Richard Burbage
entities.context: Kept the ending unmarried, and named two of the clock.

entities.name: Augustine Phillips
entities.context: Left the song as learned, and spent Nick's voice once.

entities.name: Nick Sorrell
entities.context: Showed he can wait for the black, and was released for the day.

entities.name: John Sincler
entities.context: Kept the half-line, and did not ask for a larger death.

entities.name: Love's Labour's Lost
entities.context: Mentioned in Once more, and no total

facets.activity: Rehearsed again at the Cross Keys

quotes.speaker: abel_garnish
quotes.text: The column beside Costard is open.
